reason: Adds a sidebar menu for persistently pinning, opening, and unpinning eligible DeepSeek Harness sessions using browser-local storage and public host integration points.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏添加可持久保存的会话置顶菜单，用于打开、置顶和取消置顶符合条件的会话。
summaries.en: Adds a persistent pinned-session menu to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar for opening, pinning, and unpinning eligible sessions.

capabilities: Adds a persistent pinned-session action to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar
Stores an ordered list of pinned session IDs in browser localStorage
Opens eligible sessions and supports pinning and unpinning through published Harness client services
